SLAY_SPOON_SYNC.title: Slay the Spoon
SLAY_SPOON_SYNC.body:
Mods use a separate profile with nothing unlocked at first.

Copy your regular progress into it on every launch? Your regular save stays untouched. Progress unique to modded runs will be overwritten at the next launch.

To change this choice, delete mod_configs/SlaySpoon.cfg in the game’s user folder.
SPOON_TINT.title: Character Color
SPOON_TINT.help: Allies see your color too. “Dominant color only” limits the tint to areas close to the original color. Increase the threshold to recolor more areas.
